```{r}
  ml_data_global_lofs_30 %>%

  left_join(ml_data_dist, by = "vin") %>% 
  left_join(ml_data_response, by = "vin")
```


# LOFs globaux (k = 30) -- Réclamants versus non-réclamants

## Distributions des statistiques reliées aux LOFs {.tabset .tabset-pills}

On va regarder si la distribution des statistiques calculées est différente pour les réclamants et les non-réclamants.

```{r}
plot_density <- function(data, var) {
  xlim <- quantile(data[[quo_name(enquo(var))]], probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = T)
  
  data %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = {{var}}, fill = claim_ind_cov_1_2_3_4_5_6)) +
    geom_density(color = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("#69b3a2", "#404080")) +
    ylab("Densité") +
    xlab(NULL) +
    xlim(xlim)
}
```

### Mean {-}
```{r}
plot_density(ml_data, var = global_lof_30_mean)
```

### Variance {-}
```{r}
plot_density(ml_data, var = global_lof_30_var)
```

### Skewness {-}
```{r}
plot_density(ml_data, var = global_lof_30_skewness)
```

```{r}

```


# Routnier vs pas routinier {.tabset .tabset-pills}

Ici, je pige plusieurs paires de routinier/non-routinier parmi les conducteurs de l'échantillon. La sélection des paires est faite en regardant l'histogramme de l'heure de départ des trajets.

```{r}
aug_trip_sample <- tar_read(aug_trip_sample)
global_lofs <- tar_read(global_lofs)

global_lofs_30 <- global_lofs[[which(tar_read(global_lofs_k_val) == 30)]]
```

```{r}
aug_trip_sample_global_lofs_30 <- bind_cols(aug_trip_sample, global_lofs_30 = global_lofs_30)
```


```{r}
plot_hist_time <- function(data, sub = NULL) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time_start)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 900, col = "black", fill = "white") +
    xlab("Heure") +
    ylab("Nombre de trajets") +
    labs(subtitle = sub)
}
```

## Première paire {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
routinier <- filter(aug_trip_sample_global_lofs_30, vin == "1C4PJMCS2GW172098")
pas_routinier <- filter(aug_trip_sample_global_lofs_30, vin == "19UUA56642A801987")

lof_routinier <- tibble(global_lofs_30 = routinier$global_lofs_30, vin = "routinier")
lof_pas_routinier <- tibble(global_lofs_30 = pas_routinier$global_lofs_30, vin = "pas routinier")
```

### Histogramme routinier {-}

```{r}
plot_hist_time(routinier, sub = "routinier")
```

### Histogramme pas routinier {-}

```{r}
plot_hist_time(pas_routinier, sub = "pas routinier")
```

### Comparaison des densités {-}

```{r}
bind_rows(lof_routinier, lof_pas_routinier) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = global_lofs_30, fill = vin)) +
  geom_density(color = "#e9ecef", alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("#69b3a2", "#404080")) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Local outlier factor", limits = c(0.93, 1.3)) +
  ylab("Densité")
```
